senses.gloss: also ר׳ דחגרא Sela (Petra) in Edom (v. Hildesh. Beitr. p. 52 sq.) Targ. Gen. XIV, 7 (Y. ed. Vien. רֵיקָם; h. text קדש). Ib. XX, 1; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 1:1">Gitt. I, 1</cite> <he>המביא מן הר׳ ומן החגר</he> if a messenger brings a letter of divorce from the district of R. or of Ḥagar.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 51">Sifré Deut. 51</cite> <he>ר׳ תחגרא</he> (read: <he>דחגרא</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 874:2">Yalk. ib. 874</cite> <he>רגם דח׳</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:11">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 11</cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>ורכה דדוגרא</he>, corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 15:3">Targ. Josh. XV, 3</cite>; a. e.—Sifré l. c.; Yalk. l. c. (not <cite ref="C00007"><he>גאוה</he></cite>); Tosef. l. c. (Var. <he>נאה</he>, corr. acc.); Y. Shebi. V, 36ᶜ <he>ר׳ דגועה</he>.
